description: This Python script collects license information from a VNDK snapshot directory, including reading license files, checking for specific license keywords, and aggregating license kinds.

classes.name: LicenseCollector
classes.description: A class to collect and identify license types from files in a VNDK snapshot directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LicenseCollector with the directory to scan.

methods.name: read_and_check_licenses
methods.description: Reads license text and checks for specific license keywords, updating the license_kinds set.

methods.name: check_licenses
methods.description: Reads a license file and extracts license kinds.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the license scanning process, either for all files or a specific module.
